// Plastic (R2) low-discrepancy scattering: Count terms of the additive
// recurrence whose two increments are the reciprocal first and second powers
// of the plastic number, offset by Offset in [0, 1) (0.5 is the usual choice
// and avoids the corner). No bases, no tables, and a lower discrepancy than
// Halton in two dimensions
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plastic_ratio).
type PlasticPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    Offset: Number;
}
